tokens.name: brand-ink
tokens.usage: Brand black. Logo on light grounds, dark slides, posters. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-ivory
tokens.usage: Brand ivory. Logo on dark or purple grounds, light pages. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: brand-purple
tokens.usage: Solana purple. The one accent: buttons, the sw ticker prefix, the token itself, pattern blocks. White text on it is 4.5:1; ivory text only at 24px+ (4.0:1).

tokens.name: brand-gray
tokens.usage: Supporting gray. Lines, secondary strands in diagrams, captions on black (8.1:1). Decorative only on ivory (2.1:1).

tokens.name: purple-ink
tokens.usage: Purple for small text on ivory (6.1:1): eyebrows, links, ticker prefix.

tokens.name: purple-soft
tokens.usage: Purple for small text on black (7.4:1): eyebrows, links, ticker prefix.

tokens.name: on-purple
tokens.usage: Text and icons on brand-purple (4.5:1).
